responsibility: Provides the shared function prototypes for the Epiphany target implementation, especially helpers referenced across epiphany.cc, the machine description, and custom RTL passes. It exposes interfaces for condition-code selection, compare generation, prologue/epilogue expansion, operand and call classification, function attributes, mode-switch insertion and analysis, alignment hooks, asm function entry handling, and register-renaming/scheduling helpers, serving as the declaration bridge between generated md code and the handwritten backend sources.
